SURV 2100.prereqText: EGDT 1400 , EGDT 1040 , and EGDT 1600 or MATH 1060 or equivalent, Completed and Approved Matriculation into any Surveying and Mapping degree program.

SURV 2240.prereqText: EGDT1400, EGDT 1610 or MATH 1060 or Equivalent, Completed and Approved Matriculation into any Surveying and Mapping degree program.

SURV 2310.title: Surveying US Public Lands
SURV 2310.prereqText: EGDT 1400 , MATH 1060 or EGDT 1600 and 1610 or appropriate math placement score, Completed and Approved Matriculation into any Surveying and Mapping degree program.

SURV 2320.title: Property Descriptions and Public Land Records
SURV 2320.prereqText: ( ENGL 1010 or ENGH 1005 ) and EGDT 1400 , Completed and Approved Matriculation into any Surveying and Mapping degree program.

SURV 2350.prereqText: Completed and Approved Matriculation into any Surveying and Mapping degree program
